title: BELLS-O: Evaluating the Operational Trade-offs of LLM Supervision Systems
abstract: arXiv:2606.20668v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: LLM supervision systems, namely input/output moderation filters and jailbreak detectors, are the primary safeguard against misuse in deployed AI applications, yet existing benchmarks are often vendor-biased, omit cost and latency, and rarely compare specialized guardrails against repurposed generalist LLMs. We present BELLS-O (Benchmark for the Evaluation of LLM Supervision Systems, Operational), an independent operational benchmark that evaluates 33 systems from 17 developers: specialized guardrails (e.g., Llama Guard 4, ShieldGemma-2B, Lakera Guard) and frontier generalists repurposed as supervisors (e.g., GPT-5.4, Claude Sonnet 4.6, Grok 4.1 Fast), jointly on detection rate, false-positive rate, latency, and cost. translated_title: BELLS-O：评估大语言模型监督系统的运营权衡
translated_abstract: LLM 监督系统，即输入/输出审核过滤器与越狱检测器，是已部署 AI 应用中防范滥用行为的主要安全保障，然而现有基准往往存在供应商偏向、忽略成本与延迟，并且很少将专用防护栏与改作监督用途的通用大语言模型进行比较。我们提出了 BELLS-O（LLM 监督系统评估基准·运营版），这是一个独立的运营基准，从检出率、误报率、延迟和成本四个维度联合评估来自 17 家开发商的 33 个系统：包括专用防护栏（如 Llama Guard 4、ShieldGemma-2B、Lakera Guard）以及被改作监督用途的前沿通用模型（如 GPT-5.4、Claude Sonnet 4.6、Grok 4.1 Fast）。我们覆盖了 11 个危害类别的输入/输出审核、13 种攻击技术的越狱检测以及提示注入检测，使用由手工构造的提示和精选外部数据构建的自有数据集……
tldr: 该论文提出了独立运营基准 BELLS-O，首次将来自 17 家开发商的 33 个 LLM 监督系统（专用防护栏与改作监督用途的前沿通用模型）放在检出率、误报率、延迟和成本四个维度上进行统一联合评估，弥补了现有基准供应商偏向及忽视成本延迟的不足。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces BELLS-O, an independent operational benchmark that jointly evaluates 33 LLM supervision systems from 17 developers—specialized guardrails and repurposed frontier generalist LLMs—across detection rate, false-positive rate, latency, and cost, addressing the vendor bias and missing cost/latency metrics of existing benchmarks.
